newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares slip down at noon in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares slip down at noon in thin trade.

text.p: Shanghai's foreign currency B shares slipped lower on Monday morning in anaemic trading as investors largely abandoned the market due to lack of buying interest, brokers said.
Investors were waiting for 1997 interim results and other fresh incentives before returning to the market with current, low liquidity making market players hesitant to take positions, they said.
The B share index fell 0.019 points or 0.02 percent to 76.350 points on volume of 1.992 million shares worth $828,000.
"Trading was extremely dull as few people have an interest in the market due to a lack of fresh incentives," said a broker at a foreign securities firm in Shanghai.
"Most of the B share companies have not issued their 1997 interim results, which are expected to provide the main market moving force in the short term," she said.
Listed firms are required to announce their results for the first half of 1997 by the end of August.
"Trading has not been that lively since the Hong Kong handover," said a broker at Shenyin & Wanguo Securities in Shanghai. "Investors are waiting for interim reports."
The former British colony of Hong Kong became a Special Administrative Region of China on July 1, and the passing of the event removed a major buying incentive from the market.
Of 45 B shares, 24 traded in the morning with nine flat, eight down and seven up.

Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co was the biggest B share loser as well as the most actively traded share on concerns about its interim results. It fell $0.026 or 3.49 percent to $0.720 on volume of 206,500 shares.
Penmaker Shanghai Hero Co followed as the second biggest loser due to speculative selling, ending the morning down $0.012 or 3.23 percent to $0.360.
Shanghai's domestic currency A shares fared better on Monday morning, rising slightly due to speculative buying.
The A index gained 4.406 points or 0.35 percent to 1,270.019 points on volume of 207.120 million shares worth 2.530 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index lost 3.745 points or 0.10 percent to 3,900.837 points.
Afternoon trading is expected to be quiet, brokers said.
